subject.title: docs: document optional workspace capability inventory records

question: Should OpenClaw core documentation establish `capabilities/*.md` as an optional workspace inventory convention, or should this guidance be confined to existing skills/plugins/ClawHub surfaces?
rationale: The diff is a public documentation and workflow convention, not a mechanical correction; repository policy requires maintainer product judgment for new user-facing conventions.

options.title: Accept the scoped convention
options.body: Keep the inventory-only framing and merge after the exact-head docs review confirms it does not imply automatic loading or permission changes.

options.title: Narrow to existing surfaces
options.body: Close or revise the PR so workspace skills, plugins, and ClawHub remain the only documented capability-discovery mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped convention
recommendation.body: Keep the inventory-only framing and merge after the exact-head docs review confirms it does not imply automatic loading or permission changes.
